_note: Cryostat catalog. Stage cooling power follows Q = a*(T^alpha - Tbase^alpha), anchored at (t_ref_k, cap_ref_w). cable_len_mm is the cable run from the next-warmer stage (room temperature for the first). wall_power_w is the electrical draw of ONE unit and is an assumption (compressors + pumps + control), not a datasheet value.

dilution_xld.label: Dry dilution refrigerator (XLD400-class)
dilution_xld.source: Stage temperatures, cooling powers and cable lengths: Krinner et al., EPJ Quantum Technol. 6, 2 (2019), Table 1 (measured, Bluefors XLD400). wall_power_w and max_coax_lines: assumption.

pt_4k.label: Two-stage pulse-tube cryocooler (4 K class)
pt_4k.source: Stage values as the XLD's 50 K / 4 K stages (same pulse-tube class). wall_power_w and max_coax_lines: assumption.

ambient.label: No cryostat (room-temperature apparatus)
ambient.source: Trapped-ion and neutral-atom systems in UHV chambers at ~300 K.
